column1: # Display order is line order. Every question uses its own namespaces and
# uniquely named cluster-scoped objects. Node-level setups only add files that
# no other question reads (a static Pod manifest on cka-worker2, a backup
# directory on cka-control-plane) and teardown removes them; none stops or
# reconfigures a shared component, so no question declares `breaks`.
# `requires` documents the shared dependencies the graders rely on.
